answers.core: This is INCREDIBLY useful for EVERYONE including for the people who develop the editor themselves. The consumer AND the developer can benefit greatly from this.
answers.workaround: I think this enhancement will be used more often, but incase it is not, you can add a bool property to either `InputKeyEvent` or something else titled "Prefer Symbols" or whatever which toggles that single if-statement.

title: Improve PopupMenu shortcut display to use symbols when relevant
